title: Independently check #4554's native FFT multiplier: exact error-chain recurrences, parameters to ell=200, separate fixed-grid multiplier (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/pr4554-native-fft-check/`, an independent check of the native FFT multiplier in Dugongue's #4554 (head `4f46c6a9`): the parameters in `PROOF.md` and the recovery bound `216N⁶β²/S < 2^(−10ℓ−6) < 1/4` in `FFT-ERROR.md`. It follows my #4556 on the same PR. **All checked claims are confirmed. No new κ.**

Both texts are vendored (blobs `c7b4777b` and `53691b10`, SHA256-pinned). Nothing is imported from #4554's code.

## Checks

- **Error chain, exact rationals.** Worst-case recurrences run for `N ≤ 2^20` and `β ≤ 2^8` (80 cases):
  - forward amplitudes `≤ 2·4^jβ`;
  - (1) `36N³β/S`, (2) `112N⁵β²/S`, (3) `5N⁴β²`;
  - inverse amplitudes `≤ 6·4^jN⁴β²` and `212N⁷β²/S`;
  - (4) `216N⁶β²/S ≤` (5).

  The twiddle recurrence gives `a_j ≤ 8jδ`.
- **Parameters, exact integers, every `ℓ = 2…200`.** `N < 2^(ℓ+2)`, `F+1 ≤ 2^(ℓ+7)`, (5) `< 2^(−10ℓ−6)`, `δ, η < 1`, and the raw-product word budget is within `16(F+16)+20`.
- **Separately written fixed-grid multiplier.** It follows the `PROOF.md` construction: my own Machin/Taylor root floored to the grid, floor-rounded twiddle products, conjugated forward twiddles, an unnormalized inverse, floor division by `N`, nearest-integer recovery and radix carries.
  - **Exactness.** All 367 products are exact, covering every pair for `n ≤ 4`, plus random and all-ones operands up to 12,000 bits.
  - **Observed error.** The worst observed coefficient error is **5.7·10⁻⁷ of (4)**.
  - **Magnitudes and width.** Inverse magnitudes stay below `6N⁶β²S`, and carries stay at most `L(β−1)`. Every stored value fits the global word width; the FFT uses at most 12% of it, and the root routine sets the rest.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr4554-native-fft-check
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr4554-native-fft-check outcome=completed   (~16 s, stdlib only)
```

**Limitations:**
- `ROOTS-RECOVERY.md`'s root-precision proof and the `O(n)` operation ledger are not re-derived.
- The Gaussian adapters are out of scope here; #4556 covers the banded inverse.

Head: `ebc09ef98f107da49b78b450642fd00ca1a93a74`. Base: canonical main `f626db5c`.
